purpose: Next Seed Audio pack. Only creatures that exist on the road in chapters 1 and 2. No new species, no voices, no music.
format: PCM WAV mono 44100 Hz 16 bit. One-shot, a single gesture, silence at both ends. Two variants each. Do not loop.
play_rule: Once, when the player taps that figure, or when its story card is on screen and the player is watching. Never during the catch-up journal, never in the background, never as an idle loop.

animals.also: walks along from step 13201 to 13701 only if the player fed him

animals.sound: one adult goat bleat, shared. Ramka is the nicked-ear goat who may follow from step 4500 to 13200. Matrena stands at step 13320 and is the older, wider goat. Same species, one cue, not two animals invented apart.

do_not_generate: Any animal that is not in the animals list.
A separate voice or bleat species for Matrena. She uses animal_goat with Ramka.
A.L. (agnia): step 99999, she is not on the road and cannot be tapped.

Human residents have no speech and no animal sound: kuzma, mitya, pimen, nina, vera, nil, monk_old, monk_frail, lab_anya, lab_fedor, lesnik, sawyer, brigadir, penki_worker, repka_tech, krivulya_local.
Bees, wolves, owls, horses, or any other species. Hives are scenery.
Music, dialogue, fog noise, a looping bell, a looping animal idle.
